title: Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (25 items)
description: 25 attributes rated Not true / Somewhat true / Certainly true (0–2); five 5-item scales and a total difficulties score.

citation.text: Goodman R (1997). The Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire: a research note. Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry 38(5):581–586.

scoring.text: Items 7, 11, 14, 21 and 25 are reversed. Emotional = 3, 8, 13, 16, 24; conduct = 5, 7, 12, 18, 22; hyperactivity = 2, 10, 15, 21, 25; peer = 6, 11, 14, 19, 23; prosocial = 1, 4, 9, 17, 20 (each 0–10). Total difficulties = the four non-prosocial scales (0–40). Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
